message: 歩こう

name: Melilot
message: 「I've been waiting for you, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for having me again today.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」
Over the past week, I'd been getting special training from Melilot-san while juggling my Student Council and library duties.
As for today, our day off, one thing led to another and we ended up doing a one-on-one training session.
Truth be told, I'd been thinking about asking her out somewhere together, though.
Well, we still get to spend time alone together either way...

name: Melilot
message: 「What's the matter, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your concentration is slipping.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sorry...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...There's no point in pushing yourself too hard, either.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Shall we take a short break?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here you go.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thanks...」
And so, somehow or other, I'm being treated to tea in Melilot-san's room.

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, you've improved considerably.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Compared to when you first started, you're like a whole different person.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's because you're such a good teacher, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Can you really tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's just a hunch.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Goodness, what is that supposed to mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Knowing you, Melilot-san, I figured that had to be the reason.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're just saying whatever comes to mind...」

name: Synn
message: 「I really do trust you, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, what a way to put it」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it's true……」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Giggle*……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still, it really seems like you didn't even need to push yourself to do private practice」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, though I certainly don't mind keeping you company for your practice, Sakura-kun……」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad to hear that, then」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if things turned out a little differently from what I originally had in mind……」

name: Melilot
message: 「What do you mean……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, it's really no big deal, so……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Keeping secrets isn't very admirable, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's nothing like that……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then please tell me」

name: Synn
message: 「But……」

name: Melilot
message: 「What were you dissatisfied with about today's special training?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If there was some shortcoming on my part, please point it out」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that, it's just……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well……」

name: Melilot
message: 「Come now, hiding things won't do you any good, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh……」
It's not like telling her will cost me anything, though…….

name: Synn
message: 「……I was actually planning to ask you out, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ask me out……?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um…… I just realized we only ever see each other inside the academy……」

name: Synn
message: 「So, I thought it would be nice if we could go out somewhere together...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Does that mean...」

name: Synn
message: 「We've never really done anything like that, after all...」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-What are you saying!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That sounds just like...」

name: Synn
message: 「A date... is what I was hoping for, actually...」

name: Melilot
message: 「S-Sakura-kun!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You shouldn't tease your elders! That's in very poor taste!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not teasing you at all...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm serious about you, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「T-Therefore, really...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Y-You won't get anything good out of making me embarrassed, you know...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the one who's embarrassed here...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd never say something like this if we weren't alone together...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Saying things like that so casually...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um...」
This delicate silence feels a little awkward, yet kind of ticklish, or rather...
It's agonizing and I can't bring myself to move, yet strangely enough, it doesn't feel bad at all.

name: Melilot
message: 「There's nothing to be gained from inviting someone like me out, you know...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's not about gaining anything or anything like that...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Still...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm doing it because I want to」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「I come to see you because I want to be by your side, Melilot」

name: Synn
message: 「I talk with you because I want to know more about you」

name: Synn
message: 「Even my resolve to become the Demon Lord and drive back Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's all because you're here with me」

name: Melilot
message: 「I couldn't possibly...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it wrong for me to fight Re-Crea for your sake?」
These are my true, honest, and earnest feelings.
The shape of the emotions I want to convey.

name: Melilot
message: 「For my sake...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Honestly, I'm struggling with how to answer」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't really understand it myself...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot...」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is the first time anyone has ever said something like that to me...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're the first person to ever hold feelings like that for me, Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I honestly don't know what I should do, or what I want to do」

name: Melilot
message: 「Nothing like this was written in any of my books...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The answer isn't recorded anywhere in my knowledge...」

name: Synn
message: 「...In that case」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's search for it together」

name: Synn
message: 「The two of us, for that answer」

name: Melilot
message: 「The two of us...」

name: Synn
message: 「I--no, we will definitely overcome Re-Crea」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll have all the time in the world to look for that answer afterward, won't we!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Do you think the two of us will be able to find it...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Because two people are much more reliable than one」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Pfft」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Melilot-san...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Fufu... Ah, I'm sorry...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's just that your words were so vague, despite how proudly you puffed out your chest...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Do I seem unreliable...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, not at all...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's very reassuring」

name: Synn
message: 「...Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「That's kind of embarrassing...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I think I'll try believing in you, Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'll believe in you, and we'll search for the answer together」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot...」
A translucent, radiant smile blossoms, soft and dewy like moonlight.
Down that sweetly blushing cheek, a single clear drop slides like a shooting star...
Melilot-san's tears, seen for the very first time.

name: Melilot
message: 「A-Ah... I'm sorry...」

name: Melilot
message: 「How strange... I just felt so happy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot...」
My fingertips move on their own, wiping away her warm, wet cheek.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... Aah, I'm sorry, I just...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You don't have to sit so far away, you know.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's fine if you come closer...」
Drawn in without even a moment to think by the words slipping from her glossy lips...
The distance between the two of them shrinks, with nothing to stop it...

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you care for another cup of tea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I'm good, thanks. Looks like I've stayed quite a while, huh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, I don't mind at all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「More importantly, I'm the one who should apologize, since you went out of your way to come all the way here.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If only I could have gotten ready to go out right away...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, don't worry about it. It's not like today's our only chance or anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... we can go on a date whenever...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Y-Yes, that's true...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's a relief to hear you say that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can work around your schedule, so you don't need to worry.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're usually pretty busy too, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is true...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Of course, being busy with my mission is part of it, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Um... I'm just not very used to going out into crowds, so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I need to mentally prepare myself, and things like that...」
Come to think of it, she was like that during KiraFes too...

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, I'm not trying to force you into anything.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No! It's not that I don't want to go at all!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If I'm with you, Sakura-kun, um, I think I'll be okay, and...」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, I'll definitely be okay, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then... let's take it little by little and get used to it」

name: Synn
message: 「Starting with somewhere close. Gradually moving to places further away」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes... that sounds good」

name: Melilot
message: 「You really are dependable, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That suggestion... I think it's really wonderful」

name: Melilot
message: 「Someday, when I'm finally freed from this duty...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'd love to go on a trip somewhere far away, to a place I've never been...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just the two of us, of course?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes」
For that to happen, I have to do my best and drive back the Re-Crea!

name: Melilot
message: 「...Oh, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Melilot
message: 「We can't go on a trip somewhere far away, but we can at least go for a walk, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Easy enough. I'd be happy to keep you company」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though it would only be on the academy grounds...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's totally fine. Let's go」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you usually take walks around here?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is true...」

name: Melilot
message: 「When I grow tired of my books and want to get some fresh air, and things like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, I can't really go too far away anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't mind having me along, I'll gladly join you anytime」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I'll look forward to it」
Her demeanor felt completely different from the impression Melilot-san usually gave.
While I stood captivated by the bright, cheerful smile that suddenly blossomed on her face--
Slender, pale fingers gently intertwined with mine.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Miss Melilot...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Aren't you... cold?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Oh, right...」

name: Melilot
message: 「This way is warmer, isn't it?」
Just like that, the two of us choose to remain silent.
Conversing through our joined hands...

name: Synn
message: 「Finis Tower...」
This might be the first time I've ever looked up at it so intently.

name: Melilot
message: 「...Whenever I come here, I'm reminded of the past.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Would it be better if I didn't ask?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, not at all.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've already come to terms with the unpleasant memories...」

name: Melilot
message: 「And the fond memories are mostly all about Helena, anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Helena?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It was back when I still lived in this tower...」

name: Melilot
message: 「When we first met, Helena was still just a little child.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even so, her natural vitality was as strong as ever, and she often took me out of the tower.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I did get glared at by the clan elders because of it, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha, that sounds just like Miss Helena.」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, meeting her saved me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I was able to question the clan's stubborn stance...」

name: Melilot
message: 「And I got to learn about the outside world, including studying abroad and meeting Riesling.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena led me out of the darkness.」
That was something I couldn't do.
Saving the Melilot of the past.
If so…….
Saving the Melilot of the future――
That's what I can do right now.

name: Melilot
message: 「And today……」
Into their joined hands, gently yet firmly, both of their hearts are poured.

name: Melilot
message: 「I took the hand of someone precious who will walk that path ahead with me」
Melilot's eyes, which had been looking up at the tower, turn toward me…….

name: Melilot
message: 「Where, I wonder, will you take me, Sakura-kun」
That's already decided.
Anywhere at all, as far as we want!
Just as the two of us desire…….
